issuer: the Secretaría de Comunicaciones y Transportes of the State of Tlaxcala (today the Secretaría de Movilidad y Transporte)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Orden Jurídico Nacional (SEGOB, ordenjuridico.gob.mx), which lists it as in force; Tlaxcala's own hosts (tlaxcala.gob.mx, smyt.tlaxcala.gob.mx, the Consejería Jurídica, the Periódico Oficial) reset the connection in wave 12. The Reglamento de la Ley de Comunicaciones y Transportes en el Estado de Tlaxcala en Materia de Transporte Público y Privado (signed 16 April 2008, published 17 April 2008), Word file converted to text (mx29-regl.txt). Art. 87: tipo C is the automovilista's licence, 'con vigencia de dos y cinco años' (two terms to choose from: the years stand null), and a permit is issued to those over fifteen and under eighteen (art. 87 V, art. 90); the licence's age is read from that, 18 (a reading: art. 88 asks a tipo C applicant for a birth certificate or CURP and a voting card, the latter itself held only from 18, but states no age). This settles wave 12's question of which type is the private car's (tipo C). The Secretaría (de Comunicaciones y Transportes, art. 2 XXIV) issues them (art. 86, 88); the office is the Secretaría de Movilidad y Transporte today (its host smyt.tlaxcala.gob.mx, wave 12). The Código Financiero's fee for tipo C (art. 153, read in wave 12) is by term too: fee null. Whether the 2008 Reglamento has been amended since wasn't read.
